guards.what: N1: `base.Owner.PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber <= 1` (VeryHotCocoa.cs:23) vs the sim's `self.turn <= 1` (very_hot_cocoa.py:22), including the extra-turn case
guards.rationale: `self.turn` is CombatState.turn, a different object from PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber, so the equivalence had to be established rather than assumed. Both start at 1 (PlayerCombatState.cs:37 `TurnNumber { get; private set; } = 1`; combat.py:108 `self.turn = 1`) and both advance exactly once per player turn, INCLUDING an extra turn: C# calls IncrementTurnNumber for every player in `_playersTakingExtraTurn` on the same SwitchSides path that handles a normal turn (CombatManager.cs:1404-1418, and RoundNumber -- not TurnNumber -- is the one that skips), and the sim's extra-turn branch does `self.turn += 1` before start_turn (combat.py:650-652) exactly as the normal branch does (combat.py:674-675). EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b17.py cocoa): with a listener that claims one extra turn, combat.turn reads 2 after it and the relic does not re-fire -- which is C#'s answer too. For a single-player run the two counters are the same number at every point. Rule 7: PlayerCombatState.cs, CombatManager.cs and combat.py are NOT hashed by this record.

guards.what: N4 (checked, and NOT a gap): C# fires this from AfterSideTurnStart, whose dispatcher runs a SECOND full pass of AfterSideTurnStartLate (Hook.cs:1163-1175)
guards.rationale: PROMPT.md bug class 25 says a two-pass C# dispatcher is an ordering guarantee the sim's single listener loop destroys, so this had to be checked rather than skipped. Very Hot Cocoa implements the EARLY (plain) pass, and the effect is a pure energy gain that reads nothing, so no ordering against a Late listener can change its own outcome. The generic loss of the Late slot is audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json guard G12's finding (LIVE there, on the Orichalcum x Cloak Clasp pair and on SandpitPower), not a divergence introduced by this relic. What DOES matter is recorded on relic/vexing_puzzlebox and relic/whispering_earring in this same batch: the sim collapses AfterPlayerTurnStart (step 22), AfterSideTurnStart (step 23) and the whole AutoPrePlay phase (step 26) onto one method, and there the collapse is observable. Rule 7: Hook.cs and audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json are NOT hashed by this record.
